name: Jesus Return
overview: Scripture reveals that the return of Jesus Christ will be sudden and unmistakable, like lightning shining from east to west, yet the exact day and hour remain known only to the Father, urging believers to remain watchful and ready. Signs in the heavens and turmoil on earth will precede His coming, highlighting the urgency of spiritual preparedness. Christ’s second appearance will bring salvation to those who eagerly await Him, emphasizing the hope and assurance found in His promised return.
